scenarios.description: Constructing a coordinator has no network, token, timer, or listener side effect.
Readiness follows authentication and all five complete declaration acknowledgements.
Reconnect redeclares the latest complete slices and settles their pending promise without repeating an effectful operation.
A post-handoff update queues behind the activating snapshot while every slice remains atomically visible.
A colliding activation rolls desired slices back before a later unrelated update succeeds.
Effectful operations reject before dispatch instead of waiting for a later ready session.
A delayed relay rejection keeps the first event correlation after a second event is sent.
Duplicate start is rejected, a pre-handoff declaration is superseded, and repeated stop shares one cleanup promise.
Accepted calls expose bounded progress and settle exactly once by result or CALL_ERROR.
Explicit relay rejection or cancellation terminals prove non-dispatch before acceptance, while accepted cancellation stays uncertain.
Presence is rebuilt per session and all owned resources are gone after stop.
Shadow state reaches only the beta state publisher and exposes no callable action path.
Recorded-action mode redirects device commands and notification intents to the recorder.
An effect outside the closed recorder vocabulary is rejected before reaching a sink.
